_meta.status: PROPOSED. The en sibling of the zh Unihan fold and the fr paradigm map. Wiring in trait_labelers + the shared generator claim-match consult this artifact as DATA.
_meta.law: INFLECTION = rule-generated standard morphology (the rule IS the citation); DERIVATION = admitted ONLY on a cited WordNet-'+' or Wiktextract-form-of/etymology attestation (hand-authored rows FORBIDDEN — her rule). Every row source-tagged. Un-attested candidates DROPPED (honest drop). A variant of a flag-class base INHERITS flag-class.

bases.flag_note: flag_lemmas = en_color_plant_flag() ∪ EN_COLOR_FLAG; a variant fires-with-flag.

wordnet30.channel: derivationally-related-forms '+' pointers, stem-guarded, adj-satellite pos-fixed; cross-sense '+' noise refused

wiktextract_kaikki.channel: sense form_of/alt_of onto base, or etymology 'equivalent to BASE + -SUFFIX'

inflection_collision_veto.rule: a rule-generated inflection is DROPPED when Wiktextract lists that surface as an INDEPENDENT headword (own etymology, no form_of onto our base) — a coincidental orthographic collision, not an inflection of a colour.
